# Squeaky Solutions

> Brisbane mobile car detailing at your driveway. Combined visits (The Essentials, Full Detail, Full Treatment), exterior, interior, and a maintenance plan. Morning and afternoon slots, seven days including Sunday. Pay on the day — cash or card. Ten percent of income goes towards Palestine.

Squeaky Solutions is a local Brisbane operator, not a franchise. We come to the house. Bookings confirm on the live calendar. No online payment, no deposit.
